name: CI runner host: k3s API unavailable — poweredge-xubuntu ci_lifecycle.api-unavailable > 0
description: Fires when MAX(livespec.ci_lifecycle.api-unavailable) for host.name=poweredge-xubuntu over the trailing 10 min is above 0: the lifecycle sweep saw k3s.service's main process START in its window (systemd ExecMainStartTimestampMonotonic moved: a crash-restart or a hand restart alike), or the sweep's API reads were refused. Fires once per window. A k3s restart kills in-flight runner pods, whose jobs fail at the ARC hook on ECONNREFUSED 10.43.0.1:443 (companion: 'CI hook-failure burst'), and ARC's same-name replacements can deadlock on Terminating stale-owner PVCs. Value trigger; silence is the dead-man's job. Runbook: ssh poweredge-xubuntu; journalctl -u k3s --since -30min (known cause: flannel v0.28.4 watchVXLANDevice nil-pointer panic on netlink ENOBUFS, flannel-io/flannel#2549, unfixed at v0.28.9); kubectl get pvc -A | grep Terminating. Emitter: ci-runner/k3s/phase2/runner-pod-lifecycle/scan-runner-pod-lifecycle.sh. Receiver: thewoolleyman/otel-collector config.ci-runner-host.yaml. Item: livespec-n5eudb.
